mechanism_retain_diagnostic_only_if: pooled after-cost log growth is positive
at least two of three block log growth values are positive
at least three stop transfers are confirmed
at least three paired scenarios improve versus baseline
leave-one-scenario-out pooled log growth remains positive
no one positive scenario supplies more than 60% of positive ablation log growth
reject_if: pooled log growth does not improve versus baseline

decision.controlled_failure: Reject structural risk transfer for this FAR contract. Do not tune pivot widths, MFE levels or buffer magnitudes.
decision.implementation_failure: Repair only the concrete implementation defect and rerun the same ablation; alpha variables remain frozen.
decision.improved_but_insufficient: Record the mechanism effect but do not retain it as a candidate component.
decision.retain_diagnostic_only: Retain the causal risk-ownership mechanism for a new separately defined development candidate. The current evidence cannot advance or validate it.

mechanism_contract.buffer: reuse frozen LogicConfig.stop_buffer_atr and causal current ATR
mechanism_contract.long_owner: first post-fill causally confirmed internal low above both entry and swept pool level
mechanism_contract.modification: modify the one live STOP_MARKET trigger through NautilusTrader; never cancel and replace with custom execution
mechanism_contract.short_owner: first post-fill causally confirmed internal high below both entry and swept pool level

research_question: When a core FAR trade has opened, does transferring the existing stop behind the first causally confirmed favorable five-minute internal pivot preserve partial delivery better than retaining the original auction invalidation, without changing entry selection, target, initial risk or scenario set?

single_changed_variable.ablation: after entry, the first completed five-minute internal pivot whose event and confirmation both occur after the fill and which lies beyond both entry and reclaimed pool in the predicted direction may take ownership of the stop; the existing ATR buffer is retained
single_changed_variable.baseline: original sweep-extreme or full-displacement-void invalidation remains until target or stop
single_changed_variable.name: post_entry_risk_owner

same nine baseline scenario IDs only
same passive parent entries and fills when available
same initial structural stop and external target
same D1-D3 continuous decision windows and resolution tails
